text: Very nice!  Works perfect!  Would definitely buy it if you use the Aero Press to make your coffee.

Bought these on a whim looking for some new ways to brew my Aeropress coffee. They work well, I just have to remember to remove them before popping spent grounds into the trash. Also, bonus they sell them in two-packs!

Very nicely made.  You can tell the difference between this and paper filters, and I do like the coffee better using the metal filter.  It's also nice to save a little paper in the process. My only complaint is that it's a very tight fit in my Aeropress.  I have one of the earlier ones (with the blue numbers).  It's pretty tight to get this filter (even though it is very slim) in and tighten the cover.  Hopefully it will loosen up a bit as I use it more.  Other than that, it works perfectly.  The mesh is fine enough to keep out the smaller bean particles, and it rinses off quickly and easily.  Get yourself one today!
It works!  Great product. Still haven't completely decided if I prefer paper or mesh filter but am very satisfied with it.
Fantastic product that works perfectly with the Aero Press. No more paper filters and the coffee tastes perfectly fine with no metallic taste.
I needed a new filter after my old one wore out. Works as advertized
Works well. No metallic taste and easy clean up.

These filters work fine: the fit is a bit snug, but that's to be expected considering the Aeropress wasn't designed for a metal filter. The mesh is very fine, so few grinds pass through, which is good. This is a well-made metal filter.

That said, this is not an improvement over paper filters, because it's difficult and messy to clean up. When I finish making coffee, I take the Aeropress over the trash can, unscrew the black plastic cap, and push the grinds into the trashcan. Can't do that so easily with the metal filter: instead you have to push it up until the filter is accessible and, trying not to scald yourself on boiling hot dregs, remove the filter. Then you have to shake/scrape off the grinds that inevitably cling to the filter. There are inevitably some left behind, which I then rinse into the sink, but rinsing grinds into the sink is a good way to rack up a plumber's bill, so that's not the best choice. I could wipe them off with a paper towel, but isn't that more wasteful than a little paper circle?

Some people say they taste a difference between the paper filter and the metal one, but my palate's just not that good. Locally roasted beans, freshly ground in a burr grinder make a substantial difference, but the filter doesn't seem to matter.
Too wide for the press to close it. I never use these because I do not want then to break my Aero press. Back to filters - wish they made them non bleach.
Still going strong after almost daily use 6 months later!!
Just what I expected

Coffee flavor is very close to French press now, which I very much like! Takes some getting used to for different roasts and grinds now, especially using the inverted brewing method, but I feel this filter has made the Aeropress more versatile.

Coffee flavor is very close to French press now, which I very much like! Takes some getting used to for different roasts and grinds now, especially using the inverted brewing method, but I feel this filter has made the Aeropress more versatile.
These work just as well, if not better, than the paper filters.  Was pleasantly surprised.  I just rinse them with water to clean too.
Works great!  I won't go back to the annoying paper filters now that I have these!

This filter is sturdy, easy to clean and fits my aeropress perfectly. When I want a stronger brew for long days at the office, I use my metal filter (instead of the paper filters) for that jolt of energy. Would buy this again.

i paid more than this for a single filter (which i accidentally threw out while emptying coffee grounds...). these 2 filters (a spare, in case i do the same thing again!) are as good as the more expensive one they replace - in fact, i prefer the smaller ring, which gives more space for the actual filter. there is no difference in the quality of the mesh as far as i can tell. i'm very happy with this.
works great!
Was suggested these by a friend for a greater aeropress experience, and they have lived up to the recommendation. The seller was quick and efficient.
Just OK. Only advantage to paper filters is that these are not disposable.

I am a new convert to the AeroPress, and also like to save resources (such as paper) where possible, therefore I was looking forward to getting these filters. However, these filters leave that telltale French press "sludge" in the bottom of my cup! This wasn't a problem with the AeroPress paper microfilters, and I haven't changed anything else about my brewing routine. I suppose I'll keep using them once I run out of papers, but it's a bummer.
Nothing complicated.  Works as advertised.  Great product.  I recommend it.

Love my new Aeropress. This is my second one.
Wouldn't dream of going back to a French press or drip

I was finally running out of the AeroPress paper filters, so opted to buy these and they work very well. They seem to clean up a little better than another brand I'd purchased a few years ago (sorry, name escapes me), as the ground tend to not stick to these Premium Metal Filters. Very happy with the purchase.
Great
arrived quickly... just started using... coffee tastes better than with paper filters... think i'm going to like them.
Works great, tastes great, no more paper waste.... 2 Thumbs up

I was excited about the idea of not needing to buy paper filters anymore but this does not work nearly as well. When you pour the water in it goes straight through the mesh making it much more difficult to brew the proper way. The paper filters hold the liquid allowing you time to pour water over the grinds and stir a bit if you'd like before putting the plunger over it to create the suction. The metal filters don't do that at all and defeats the purpose of the aero press. If I had not already gotten rid of the packaging I would probably send this back.
These are fine; I didn't give them a 5 as the paper filters seems to make a better coffee.
I replaced my fine mesh stainless filters with these. Pressing my fine grind coffee is now easier with these filters. I love em'!
So easy! And love that we don't have to worry about buying filters again! Came quickly and seems to be a quality product!
I like it so far as it eliminate the need to purchase paper filters, however, it filtered out everything, including crema.
Works well and is easy to clean, very pleased!
Fits great in the filter.

The product itself is sturdy enough and seems like it would last a long time.  The issue I have is with the flow of the coffee through this filter.  It is much too fast and completely defeats the purpose of the AeroPress.  I was so disappointed.  I really wanted this to work!

I use this along with a paper filter each time I make my cup of Aeropress coffee. Together they work really well and my coffee comes out tasting delicious. Also an added bonus that they include a second metal filter in case you lose the first.
They work! And they are environmental friendly.
Work perfectly, exactly as advertised.
Great coffee filter. Cleans up easily.
So far love it!  Flavor is just as good as filters and much easier to use.  I will be ordering more for the other Aeropress' I own.
Got clogged nearly immediately. Back to paper for me.
Love not using bleached throw away filters for my aeropress. I feel even better now about my awesome coffee in the am!
The fit and clean up is a little bit more difficult than the regular paper filters, but it is nice not having to buy more every couple of months, plus it is more convenient for traveling.
Fits great. Works well. Completely satisfied!

I came across this when purchasing an Aeropress as a gift. Have been using mine for years and thought I'd give the metal filter a try. It fit perfectly and cleaned easily. Just when I thought the Aeropress couldn't get any better....

I purchased these metal filters along with the AeroPress coffee maker.  I prefer using permanent filters even though I do expect a compromise.  So far, I have not found the compromise. For my first few uses of the Aeropress and this filter, I used Major Dickason coffee that was ground by the Peet's Coffee folks for "flat filters" which is s finer grind than you get "off the shelf." It must be the right grind, because there are never stray grounds in my coffee. I actually purchased the Aeropress and this filter for travel, but after being amazed and  impressed with the taste of my coffee, I have continued to use it, giving my automatic coffee maker the day off more often than not. I use a soft brush under running water to clean the filter, then dry it and place it in the Aeropress for storage.  Being flat and small, it would be easy to lose, so I follow the directions provided with the Aeropress to clean and dry all parts before enjoying your coffee.  Works for me.

I love this filter and I wish I had purchased it sooner! I think the coffee tastes better than with the paper filters. Also, when I use the paper filters, the coffee frequently leaks out onto the outside of the cup/container that I am using. With this filter I don't have that problem. I use the inverted method and this filter works great for that! If you're on the fence about switching to a reusable filter, give this a try! You won't regret it!
Works well
ideal accessory and a backup in case you accidentally pop one into the trash.
This thing doesn't work. What a piece of junk. Returned it right away.
Leaks a bit

I used paper filters for a year then gave these metal filters a try and I can't tell much of a difference.  For those of you who think they are messier than disposable filters, here's a hint;  after pressing the coffee run cold water over the filter end of the Aeropress for a few seconds--then you'll find that the metal filter comes off the coffee grounds cleanly without any muss or fuss.

Even a #10 grind bean will not slow the process down through these filters. You do not need a press, because there is nothing left TO PRESS!
I even tried using BOTH screens... same disappointing results. Conclusion: Junk. Save your money.
Great replacement for paper filters.

This is a great product and I love it in theory- it worked just fine and I love that its reusable. HOWEVER-

If you are like me, a long time aeropress user and caffeine junkie who ejects their grounds (with paper filter) into the trash after unscrewing the top, usually while you're still pretty groggy, you will wind up accidentally throwing away your metal filter. Twice. And pawing through the garbage like a raccoon trying to find it. Sadly I decided to go back to paper because doing this twice in one week that I wasn't ready to retrain myself.

Read the reviews and purchased this item. Some of the reviews stated that the water just went right through. I used the filters and found those reviews to be false. The water goes through a little bit but no more than if you used a paper filter. No coffee grounds went through. Very impressed with this product and would highly recommend if you don't want to keep buying paper fillers.

I've been using this now for about a year and a half and it is excellent. Functions as described, cleans well, has not tarnished or otherwise shown any signs of wear. They provided two filters with the order and I wonder if I'll ever need the second. Maybe if I lose the first... Allows natural coffee oils to stay in the cup, very tasty. Highly recomended add on to the amazing Aero Press.

I used up all the filters that came with my aeropress. Prompting me to buy these. Wish I bought them sooner. Being able to taste the oils that would otherwise be filtered from the coffee is worth every penny!
Just tried this out for the first time. Worked great! So far, so good.
Fits perfectly in the aeropress,  love not having to buy more filtered. Works great.
Use our filters every morning and they work great.
Both filters broke after only a few uses.  I've used a similar filter for 2 years with no problem.
great! fit the aeropress well
Superior to paper filters, and more more convenient.

This seems to be a good kit that replaces many, though not all, of the original plastic parts with metal.  Unfortunately, the axles of the wheels, one of the weakest links of the original system, are still plastic, though they are now held on with metallic screws.  As one previous reviewer mentioned, maybe Kitchenaid (or someone) will make a replacement available for just the wheels and axles, as I suspect these will eventually wear out.  But this is a far more robust system than the original, no question.  I also agree with other previous reviewers that the original design was defective and that Kitchenaid should have made these parts available to owners of their products for free (or at no more than cost).  Too bad that nowadays about the only thing that prompts companies to do the right thing is the threat of lawsuits.  Only the smartest of companies have the foresight to create customers for life.  Kitchenaid's approach works to quite the opposite.
After watching the installation, this was very easy to do, this is much better than the original was glad I did not have to replace my dishwasher.Thanks for the quick shipping.
Great! Thank You.  Watched the Video on U Tube to Install and had no problems.

When the flimsy upper rack roller on my Kitchen Aid KUDS30IXSS4 finally broke, I decided to get a replacement kit to fix it myself. I am terrible at DIY projects, and was skeptical whether this part would properly fit my Kitchen Aid dishwasher. I decided to order this through Amazon anyway.. and am glad I did. Replacing the broken roller assembly was a breeze and took about 15 minutes. The replacement also looks sturdier. To other DIY-challenged readers, here's a couple of tips:
1)you tube has an excellent step-by-step video showing how to remove the old piece and install this kit. Search "w10712394 appliance video". See video posted by appliancevideo.com
2) You need a T15 standard Torx screwdriver to install the kit. The Whirlpool kit does come with an "adapter" that allows you to use a Phillips screwdriver instead, but it is probably a worthwhile investment to spend the extra $3 to get the T15 Torx screwdriver.

Good luck!
Much improved product over the factory original part. Although this part is advertised as Whirlpool part I installed it on our Kitchen Aid dishwasher. Probably the same manufacture.

much improved over the original design.  should probably have been recalled and provided for free.  instructions are adequate at best but not a hard job once you get it down.  black and white photos in instructions are hard to see, and none of the parts are labeled despite being referred to by their technical name.  star driver adapter was a nice bonus - look for it buried in the crevice of the box.
Wonderful just exactly what I was expecting.

This is the fix for screwed up disintegrated plastic rollers on a kitchenaid dishwasher upper (adjustable) rack.  Thanks to another reviewer I bought this instead of the direct replacement.  Hopefully it holds up better.  looks like it should

So far so good! After going through a couple of the poor quality plastic replacement kits, I wanted to give this a try. I can tell from the superior materials that it is likely to far outlast the previous plastic ones. If it doesn't I'll update this review.

Having installed replacements before, I found this one quite easy. I didn't even read the directions or watch the video (though I'm quite mechanical and so I'm not suggesting it'll be easy for everyone,it won't be!)

My top rack always squeaked when rolling. One day it came crashing down and I saw the axles for the wheels had decomposed in the caustic environment of a dishwasher. Sears Parts Online showed the part in a diagram but had no part number or alternative. A call to the help desk was able to give me the part number. As you can see from the other reviews the original design was so bad it was doomed to fail with its all plastic body. This replacement, which fits many Kenmore Elite, Kitchen Aid, and Whirlpool models, uses stainless steel on the axle. The rest of the parts are just to replace height adjustor.

Assembly from the directions is near impossible due to the dark photographs provided without detail. Look for the YouTube video titled "Whirlpool, Kenmore, KitchenAid - Dishwasher Replacement Rack Adjuster Kit # W10712394 V-rail" You will see that it can assembled in minutes. You will definitely need a T-15 Torx screwdriver. A small flat screwdriver can help remove the old parts.

Once back in the washer it seems to roll better. No squeaks. The adjustment only seems to be high or low, but I always keep it in the high position. I am very happy to have the washer back to a condition better than new.
Replaced oem kenmore top bracket that was completely plastic.  Entire swap process took less than 10 minutes,
Seems much sturdier than the OEM bracket.

I bought this kit as it is a much more solid adjuster than the original and I don't want to repair every 9-18 months.  I bought the T15 Torx screwdriver to go with it, but the kit came with a Philips to Torx adapter.  I followed the instructions on the YouTube video at [...] and the installation took less than 20 minutes.  The video had complete step by step instructions and clear demonstrations.  I'm very pleased with this purchase.
Lots of work, but worth it.
easy  to replace do not bu torx scewdriver they give you a addaper in box

The parts are metal and secure! I just have PTSD after having items crash into the door it's taking me a while to know this product is reliable and it won't happen again. I'm loving it. About fifteen life changing minutes.

This is the part that Kenmore should have included in the original dishwasher. It has metal as well as plastic parts and is much more durable. I have no complaints about either the part or the seller. In fact when the order arrived, there was a small hole in the bag and a crucial small part was missing. I emailed the seller later on a Friday afternoon and received a reply within an hour. A replacement piece was quickly shipped to me and I was able to complete the repair. 5 stars for outstanding customer service!
I received it very fast and good product!!
Looked harder to install than it really did. Big improvement over the original.

This is definitely sturdier than the old style, which we had already replaced once and broke again. However, this one protrudes into the cup area slightly, so you can only put shorter cups directly under it, which is a little annoying.
Upgraded from old plastic support that broke every year. We will see how lo g this one lasts for. The rollers and axles are still plastic. Happy that they are addressing the issue though.
Easy install and great fit. Perfect replacement

This adjuster fits a large swath of brands and models of dishwasher. The wheels on my dishwasher went bad, and I needed to replace it. The stainless steel adjustment was attractive, because the old one was all plastic. The swap out was a breeze, it took me about 45 mins. to knock it out. I don't know if this is a new thing or not, but other reviews said that you needed a torx driver. The screws are in fact torx, but in my hardware bag was included a little Phillips to torx adapter. I already owned the proper bit,  but I didn't need to dig them out. On the off chance that this isn't in every set, I do recommend that you get the proper bit if you don't have it. The adapter is the black colored thing with the hardware. Also, other reviewers stated that the directions were inadequate. I thought they were fairly decent, though I did watch a Video prior to doing the job so I knew what I was getting into.
Works like a charm. The upper dishwasher rack glides very smoothly.
Very simple install, too bad the washer didn't come with this.
It fits great and is easy to install.
combined with the video suggested by other reviewers this was a very easy fix.  20 minutes tops and we were back in business.

Our dishwasher top rack broke with the original plastic parts so we ordered this universal Kenmore kit and it worked perfect and it is stainless steel better than the original all plastic pieces. Also, it was cheaper than the sears website by $10.

Seems to be much better than the original equipment. I have replaced the original once before. The plastic tabs that hold the wheels keep breaking. This is part redesigned with the sides being made of stainless steel vs the original plastic. Looks to be much better, time will tell.
A lot better than the parts we replaced !
Great Product!

Like many others, I've had multiple of the cheap adjuster kits (W10350376) break - the wheels break off within 6 months. Just installed this metal adjuster in our Kenmore Elite and it works perfectly (so far). The instructions are a little hard to read, but it's really pretty easy to install.
easy to install and I believe looks more durable than original, only time will determine for sure.

The product is great... It saved an otherwise terrific washer from the landfill.  But I'll say one thing... The instructions suck.  There photos are grainy and the written instructions difficult to decipher.  Thankfully, Sears had a video tutorial that was well made and easy to follow.

The top rack adjuster on our dishwasher was plastic and parts broke twice in a year of buying it. We replaced them with this kit and it was easy to do. No breakage so far. You can tell right away that the parts are superior to the factory installed ones as soon as you pull the top rack out and push it back in. This is what should be in there when you first buy the very expensive dishwasher we have.
Great kit followed the YouTube video as others suggested.  15 minutes start to finish.
Easy swap...directions are ok, photos are iffy but procedure shouldn't pose problems to anyone. This replacement kit is built well and is a huge improvement over the original design!

Bummed that the original parts had too much destined-to-fail plastic, but his replacement appears to be a substantial improvement. It seems like there are a lot of parts, but it's really pretty simple to install. Google W10712394, go to videos, and pick one.

Easily installed, high-quality parts. Saved a lot of money by doing this myself. I didn't even look at written instructions, based on reviews I went to YouTube video that walks you through each step.
Fits perfect!  Works like new again.

Installed only this week. Time will tell.  Whirlpool has improved on the original cheap/poor design.. This is my 3rd set.  This new design is definitely looking to be of better materials; more metal and less plastic.  I can't believe the original design.  It was crap.  Next dishwasher I purchase will not be made by Whirlpool.  They don't produce the quality they used to.  In time if this part holds up I'll increase rating.

Used this to upgrade the cheap plastic parts that came with the dishwasher. Worked perfectly. An upgrade

There are only 4 screws required for the whole thing.  It took me about 10 minutes for the whole effort.  The instructions are adequate but not great.  It will take you a couple of minutes to figure out what to do and then maybe 5 minutes to put it all together.

I liked this product as it has everything you need to replace Dishwasher upper rack, the material looks and fields with a somewhat tough material that can last for a while, i decided to buy 2 replacements just in case i needed the second one. the installation process was somewhat easy, the steps are simple and but the images are a little hard to see. i do recommend this product for anyone looking to replace his dishwasher upper rack with ease.

Much better design than the original. Like others, the clips holding the wheels on started breaking off and my rack started to fall off the rails. This new design looks like it will stand the test of time.

I had resorted to jury-rigging broken parts before that had failed as well and I found this kit. The whole replacement kit is cheaper than some of the original individual replacement parts and the installation is quite easy. With the new parts in place it is almost like having a new dishwasher. The original design and construction of the brackets for the upper rack were terrible. This is a remarkable improvement!

There is a great YouTube video with helpful instructions as well
